tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find Pokemon cards by name, set or number. Returns PokeInvest IDs to pass to the other tools, with the ungraded and PSA 10 price when known. Example: "Charizard base set 4", "Umbreon VMAX 215".

tools.name: get_card_prices
tools.description: What a card sells for: the median of completed sales for ungraded copies and for every grade at PSA, CGC, BGS, TAG, ACE and SGC, with sale counts, window, low/high, the newest sale, PSA and CGC population totals, the card page, a buy link, and the cheapest verified live eBay copy when one exists.

tools.name: get_population
tools.description: PSA population report for a card: copies graded at each grade, total, gem rate and when it was last updated.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Weekly price per grade back to 2022: date, median, sale count, window.

tools.name: get_population_history
tools.description: PSA population over time for a card (total, PSA 10, PSA 9 by date).

tools.name: get_sales
tools.description: The completed sales behind a price: date, price, grader and grade, platform, listing title. Up to 500 newest; filter by grade ("PSA 10", "RAW") and days.

tools.name: identify_card_photo
tools.description: Identify a Pokemon card from a photo URL (raw card or slab, any angle): the top candidates with PokeInvest IDs, prices and population. 91% right card on 1,000 real eBay photos, 95% in the top 3. Same-art variants (1st Edition, reverse holo) cannot be told apart; show the top 3.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Today's best verified eBay deals across every card: live listings priced under what the card sells for at that grade (title, photo and price all checked), with the saving and a buy link.
